final_message:
All 16 tests pass now. Four were failing before; I fixed two bugs in `slugkit/`, each checked against `SPEC.md`.

| Fix | File | Spec |
|---|---|---|
| Accented letters were being replaced with the separator. They now fold to plain ASCII (`è` → `e`), and other non-ASCII characters are dropped. | `slugkit/slug.py` | 1.1 |
| Runs of punctuation or spaces now become a single separator (`[^a-z0-9]` → `[^a-z0-9]+`). The separator is now inserted literally, so special characters in it can't break the substitution. | `slugkit/slug.py` | 1.2 |
| Truncation now counts a separator sitting exactly at position `max_len` as a valid cut point (search bound `max_len` → `max_len + 1`). Before, `truncate("the-quick-brown-fox", 15)` gave `the-quick` instead of `the-quick-brown`. | `slugkit/truncate.py` | 2.2 |
